newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Tuesday, dealers said.

On Monday, the October contract settled 0.03 cent higher at 11.12 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.12 to 11.08 cents. Second-position March went out 0.01 cent firmer at 11.26 cents, while the back months closed 0.03 and 0.01 cent higher.
An estimated 4,307 lots changed hands on the day.
The market is expected to maintain its recent trading range unless the October contract can stage a rally over 11.22 cents, or break its downside target of 11.00 cents, dealers said.
LIFFE white sugar futures were narrowly mixed on Tuesday. At 0846 EDT/1246 GMT, LIFFE spot August stood 10 cents lower at $326.60, while October rose 10 cents to $317.00.
